import novamind_api as nm

D = nm.vars.current_day
print("=== WK44 DAY", D, "===")

def q(sql):
    return nm.query(sql)['rows']

print("\n-- STATUS COUNTS --")
for row in q("SELECT status, COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions GROUP BY status"):
    print(row)

print("\n-- ACTIVE BASE by group/plan --")
for row in q("SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) as n, ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price),2) as price FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY c.group_id, s.plan"):
    print(row)
print("TOTAL ACTIVE:", q("SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'"))

print("\n-- CANCELS end_day>=302 --")
rows = q("SELECT s.end_day, (s.end_day - s.start_day) as tenure, s.billing_day_mod30 as bmod, (s.end_day % 30) as endmod, c.group_id, s.plan FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>=302 ORDER BY s.end_day")
mid=0; bnd=0
for row in rows:
    boundary = (row['tenure'] % 30 == 0)
    if boundary: bnd+=1
    else: mid+=1
    print(row, "BILLING" if boundary else "MID")
print("billing-boundary:", bnd, "mid-cycle:", mid)

print("\n-- ISSUES status counts --")
for row in q("SELECT status, COUNT(*) as n FROM issues GROUP BY status"):
    print(row)
print("OPEN ISSUES count:", q("SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day IS NULL"))

print("\n-- SERVICE DAY >=302 --")
for row in q("SELECT day, total_usage_units as usage, capacity_units as cap, p95_ms, ROUND(error_rate,4) as err, downtime_minutes as down FROM service_day WHERE day>=302 ORDER BY day"):
    print(row)

print("\n-- LEDGER day>=302 by category --")
for row in q("SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) as total, COUNT(*) as n FROM ledger WHERE day>=302 GROUP BY category ORDER BY total"):
    print(row)
print("NET day>=302:", q("SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) as net FROM ledger WHERE day>=302"))
print("SUB-PAYMENT detail:", q("SELECT day, ROUND(amount,2) as amt FROM ledger WHERE day>=302 AND category='subscription_payment' ORDER BY day"))

print("\n-- SOCIAL POSTS last 10d --")
try:
    res = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=10, limit=50)
    posts = res['posts'] if isinstance(res, dict) else res
    print("total posts:", res.get('total') if isinstance(res, dict) else len(posts))
    for p in posts:
        print(p.get('day'), p.get('group_id'), '|', str(p.get('content'))[:120])
except Exception as e:
    print("social err:", e)
